bound: Bounded repetition: at most 41 characters scanned per start position, so the cost is O(41 * n), linear in the text length. The analyser cannot treat 40 as a constant.
Only ever applied to the userAgent option, which is capped at 200 characters (USER_AGENT_MAX) before the pattern runs.
Applied to capLength(value, 256): quadratic on at most 256 characters.
Applied to capLength(value, MAX_CONTACT_TEXT) with MAX_CONTACT_TEXT = 1000: about 10^6 steps worst case (1.4 ms measured).
A title longer than MAX_TITLE_PARSE_LENGTH = 200 is never passed to the pattern: cubic on at most 200 characters.
A value longer than 64 characters is never passed to the pattern (capLength(v, 64) === v).
enforcedBy: relative dates, World Bank dates and the userAgent contact marker at their caps
